### Read settled browser state in `shinytest2`

`mascot_test_state()` waits for a mascot element in a `shinytest2` browser
session to mount and finish any active transition, then returns the displayed
`id`, `character`, `mood`, `status`, `bubble` and `minimised` state:

```{r mascot_test_state-call, echo = FALSE}
htmltools::tags$pre(htmltools::tags$code(paste0(
  'app <- shinytest2::AppDriver$new(app_dir)\n',
  'app$click("save")\n',
  'state <- mascot::mascot_test_state(app, "helper")\n',
  'testthat::expect_identical(state$mood, "happy")'
)))
```

Unlike `mascot_server_state()`, which reads queued session state without a
browser, `mascot_test_state()` reads what the visitor actually sees (including
active `watch_mascot_shiny()` overlays) and takes the full DOM id (such as
`"form-helper"` inside a `"form"` module).

```{r mascot_test_state-mistakes, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_mistakes_html("mascot_test_state", studio_character)
```
